svg.desc: CROWN ascent plates: nine torn-gouge ladder constructions, two relief bands, one end-seal. Book IV, Discipline and Cultivation.

symbol.title: Sealed threshold tablet with steps and star
Unequal rank tiers with a single tick
Braided ladder, choked foot and open crown
Ascending chevrons cut by an eagle strike
Unequal twin ladders joined by one hot rung
Grand-style edifice with a bow-bent rail
Bird's-eye arc band with thinning steps
Hammer wedge striking the top step
